name: sctwas_atlas

download_files.description: All significant single-cell eQTLs across all cell types used in the database. ~1.3M rows estimated (127MB / ~100 bytes per row). This is the INPUT data to scTWAS, not the scTWAS output associations.
34 trait records with EFO/MeSH/MONDO ontology mappings (Reported Trait, Ontology Label, MeSH ID, EFO ID, MeSH Type, Synonyms, Description)
30 cell type records with Cell Ontology IDs (Reported Name, Ontology Name, Cell Ontology ID, Synonym, Link, Description)

16,470+ gene annotations with Ensembl IDs, gene symbols, NCBI Gene ID, location, type, description (Ensembl ID, Gene Symbol, Synonyms, OtherID, MapLocation, Chromosome, GeneStart, GeneEnd, GeneType, Description)

fields.notes: Cell type name — matches Cell Ontology terms

primary_key.field: composite: Ensembl ID + Cell Type + Cell Condition + SNP ID
primary_key.notes: One eQTL row = one SNP-gene-celltype-condition association. Composite key needed as same gene can have multiple eQTL associations across cell types.

plugin_inputs.primary_key_field: composite: Ensembl ID + Cell Type + Cell Condition + SNP ID

critical_gap.description: The 2,765,211 scTWAS ASSOCIATIONS (the primary value of this database) are NOT bulk-downloadable. They are stored in MySQL and accessible only via the web interface. The ingested file (Allstudies_sig_eQTL.txt) contains only the INPUT sc-eQTL data (~1.3M SNP-gene-celltype associations), not the TWAS output associations linking traits to genes in specific cell types.
critical_gap.recommendation: Ingest sc-eQTL file as useful approximation; contact authors for TWAS associations bulk export for full value realization.
